forms:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>! <$pkcry;1(1,2)>!
<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,9)>Ugh, what’s up with me lately? I can’t make any flames.

<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>You havin’ some trouble, pal? I wouldn’t know what
that’s like—I’m always in rare form!
<$motion(2,850)><$voicel(2,9)>Check this out: BAM! FLAMES! Anytime, anywhere, I can
just BWOOSH! You see that? <$motion(2,850)><$voicel(2,8)>BWOOOSH!

<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Hmph... It’s not THAT impressive...<$comcan(1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)> CYNDAAA!!!
<$comeff(1,18)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>It’s no use. I’m never gonna make fire on my own... *sniffle*

<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Maybe you’re just tryin’ too hard, y’know? Here, take a
deep breath and try lettin’ go of that frustration. Relaaax.
<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>OK, now try again.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,6)>Like this?
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah, that’s the stuff! Now try to do one big BWOOOSH!<wait(0.4)><$motion(1,850)><wait(1.2)>
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>It worked! IT WORKED! Wow, thanks a bunch, <$cdef(27)>Quilava</color>!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Ha! Don’t mention it.
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,5)>Your flames still look pretty puny, though. Better keep
practicin’ if you wanna spit fire like me!

<$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,9)>GRRR! Just you wait—soon I’m gonna make WAY bigger
flames than you ever could!

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>...But then this HUGE tree came crashing down! I was
stuck, so I decided to use a move that—
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Huh? *sniff sniff*
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>What is it?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>I just caught a whiff of a real good smell. Is someone
bakin’ bread nearby?
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>Bread? I don’t smell anything like that...

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>No, I’m definitely picking up on a bready smell!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>It’s gettin’ stronger! *sniff sniff* Wait, it’s coming from...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Coming from...?
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)><$textsize(2)>From YOU, <$cdef(27)>Dachsbun</color>!</textsize>

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Is it? Oh, silly me! I should have realized.
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Well, I’m glad we sorted that out. Please continue your
story... <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)><$cdef(27)>Quilava?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Y’know, ya look a lot like bread, too, <$cdef(27)>Dachsbun... And
maybe you’d taste like bread if I took a bite outta ya...

<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>Quilava, you must be hungry. Why don’t I go and find
a nice berry for you, hm?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>*stare*...
It’s floating...

<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Has my little flower caught your eye? Well, this little one
is quite shy. <$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,5)>Stare at it too long and...see?
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Wha—?! Whoa!
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh dear. I told you it was shy. Seems it hid itself away!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Huh?! How—?! What’d you do?!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>Me? Why, I didn’t do a thing.

<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>Yeah right! There’s gotta be some kinda trick to it. You got
psychic powers? Maybe ya teleported it or somethin’?

<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Perhaps...but then again, perhaps not. Who can say? Good
luck trying to figure it out. <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,10)>Hee hee... ♪
<$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,7)>Awww, c’mon! This is gonna drive me CRAZY!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,4)>Hmmm...
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)><$cdef(27)>Rookidee</color>! What’s wrong?

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I wish I could fly way, WAY higher than I can right now...
But how can I do that?
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, that’s an EASY fix! Just leave it to me!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh? Really?! But uh... What are you gonna do?

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,5)>Hehe, aaall will become clear! Just hold on a second!
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,8)>HYUP! <$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,10)>HRAH! HYAAAA!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, WOW! You’re REALLY strong! But why are you doing
that all of a sudden?

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>This is my tried-and-true warm-up for just about anything!
I gotta get all PUMPED UP if I’m gonna send you FLYIN’!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Er, you don’t mean you’re gonna... I mean... With that
hammer...?
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>Yup! I’m gonna launch ya WAAAY up into the sky!

<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Uhhhhhh, you know what, I, um—I’m suddenly feeling
scared of heights! Really, REALLY scared!
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,10)>So sorry, but maybe next time!

<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,7)>Awww... For real?! Well, OK, but you know who to call if
you ever change your mind!
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,807)><$comeff(2,10)>Mrooow... I feel all twitchy.
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>What’s the matter, <$cdef(27)>Sprigatito</color>?

<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Espeon, whenever I see your tail...my whole body gets all
itchy and twitchy!
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,51)>That’s a little, ah, concerning...
<$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,814)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,5)><wait(0.5)><$motionoff(1,644)>Sprrrowr!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Goodness, that was a close one! ♪

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,58)>Um, I’m sorry! I just can’t help it! Your tail <$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,806)><$comeff(2,14)>makes me
wanna grab it SO BAD...
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,814)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(1,644)>Sprrrowr-rowrrr!
<$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,805)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Oh dear, you almost had it that time!
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,18)>Awww... You knew JUST where I was gonna pounce!

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>The full moon the other night was truly stunning to behold.
It reminded me of the jewel on your forehead.
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Is that so? How lovely... I would have liked to see it myself.

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>The night breeze is cool and comforting. Would you like to
stay up late with me tonight to feel it?

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Yes, that could be nice every once in a while.
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>While we’re on the subject, why don’t you try waking up
early? I have so much I’d like to show you, too.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Like how the flowers glisten as the sun begins to rise...
The way the light bounces off their petals is a thing of
exquisite splendor.

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Ah yes, I would imagine their beauty is quite unlike that of
the swaying flowers beneath the moon’s light.

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Why hello, <$cdef(27)>. The two of us were
just
discussing
some
beautiful
scenery
we’ve seen.
<$emotion(1,64)><$voicel(1,5)>Have you spotted any spectacular sights recently?

<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,9)>A sea of sparkling stars... How splendid! That sounds like
an ideal setting for an all-night soiree.

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>The night has many wondrous offerings.
<$cdef(27)><$cdef(27)>
and
I
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,8)>would be
happy to
guide
you
through
the
nocturnal world.

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>A blue sky... Why does that make me feel nostalgic?
Still, an adventure under the sun doesn’t sound half bad.

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I hope you’re excited. There are so many wonderful things
in this bright and beautiful world for me to show you!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>And after that, I found the most fascinating object while
I was out for a stroll—
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Err... <$cdef(27)>Dusclops</color>?

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>Umbreon. You speak to me so normally. Why do you do it?
<$emotion(2,64)><$voicel(2,4)>I do not scare you?
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Scare me? Why would you?

<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>I am often told so—that I am scary.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>I scare me too. In a recent time, I saw a bright red light on
the water at night. It scared me. But then I noticed...
<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,4)>It was my eye reflection!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>You were frightened by your own reflection? Heh heh!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>You always tell the most amusing stories, <$cdef(27)>Dusclops!
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)><$cdef(27)>Umbreon</color>...

<$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Heh heh. Now then, shall I continue my story? Or if you
prefer, we could go for a stroll together.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Any activity is enjoyable when I’m with you, <$cdef(27)>Dusclops.
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Thank...you. Heh. Heh. We are friends. It is happiness!
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,7)>Ugh... How annoying.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,29)>Oh dear, whatever is the matter, <$cdef(27)>Misdreavus</color>?

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Well, I love giving folks a good scare.
<$emotion(1,49)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m kind of an expert at sneaking up on folks without
being noticed.
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,14)>Well, I think that’s quite impressive!

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>But YOU always catch on before I can get close...
How come?

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>Dear me, why could that be? Maybe I just have a sense for
these things.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Even when I’m super stealthy and approach from behind,
you always notice... <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)>It’s like you’ve got eyes on your tail.

<$voicel(2,6)>Well, I do, dear. See?
<$textsize(2)><$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,814)><$pkcry;0(2,4)>!<$emotion(1,5)>
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,17)>Ugh, great... Now I’M the one who got scared.

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>It seems you’ve still got some more training to do,
<$cdef(27)>Misdreavus. ♪
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Hey! HEYYY!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>What’s all that shouting about? Did you need me for
something?

<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>No, not you! I’m trying to talk to <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>that li’l round Pokémon
behind you.

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>The little round Pokémon behind... Oh! You mean...?
<$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,7)>Right, yes—I’ll call them for you! HEEEY!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>“Yeees? Are you talking to me?”

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Nice! I didn’t think you heard me.
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Anyway, let’s go play!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>“Oh, yes, let’s! What would you like to do, dear?”

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Um... Uhhh... I didn’t think this far ahead! Hmmm...
<$comeff(2,20)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, I got it! Let’s have a contest to see who has the more
jaw-some jaw! I found some nice-looking boulders earlier.
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,8)>Whoever can crunch ’em up fastest wins!

<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,3)>What? A boulder?! Err, I mean...<$comeff(2,6)>
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,1)>“Umm, you see... Actually...I bit into a really hard berry
earlier <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,1)>and hurt my mouth.
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,2)>“So maybe we should do that another time...”
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, OK! We can save that for next time!

<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Phew... <$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)>That was a narrow escape, but all’s well that
ends well!

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>You know many things. How did you become <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>knowing of
so many things?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm... I’m not really sure. <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Maybe it’s because I got
an update?
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Up-date? I do not know it.

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Uhhh, to put it simply—it makes your brain work better!
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>If you got one, you’d be able to remember all SORTS
of stuff!

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Amazement! I want to do it! I want an up-date... <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>But I do
not know how it is done.

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh yeah—I would always just ask the humans for ’em.
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>I’m actually not sure how it all works... Sorry!

<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Oh. Sadness. I wanted to become knowing of many things
like you.

<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>OH! I’ve got it!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>When the humans get back, we’ll just ask THEM to update
you! <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Easy-peasy!
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh! That is an idea that is very smart!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>I wonder... If I got ANOTHER update, <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>do y’think I’d get
EVEN SMARTER?

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,8)>Yes. I think you would become knowing of many
more things!
<$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh. I am filled with excitement of a sudden nature!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>Let us hope, <$cdef(27)>Porygon2! We must hope that the humans will
return in a small amount of time!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,9)>La di da di da... ♪ I’m on top of the world! ♪
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>La di da di da... ♪ I’m on top of the world! ♪
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Uh, hey, <$cdef(27)>Mime Jr.</color>... Do you like to dance too?
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Uh, hey, <$cdef(27)>Mime Jr.</color>... Do you like to dance too?

<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,5)>...Ohhh, I see—you’re playing Copycat! In that case, how
about this?
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Twirl twiiirrrlll!

<$comeff(2,3)><$voicel(2,5)>...Ohhh, I see—you’re playing Copycat! In that case, how
about this?
<$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,8)>Twirl twiiirrrlll... Oops!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,9)>Let’s not slow down now... How about this? <wait(0.6)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,8)>And this?
<$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,9)>Let’s not slow down now... How about this? <wait(0.2)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Uagh!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,9)>Next, let’s do some spinning! Spin and <wait(0.5)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,8)>spin and <wait(0.6)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,8)>spin!

<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,4)>Next, let’s do some—gwah!
<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,663)><$voicel(2,2)>Ugh, I can’t keep up!
<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Maybe I don’t need to try to copy you, <$cdef(27)>Kirlia...

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>Y’know, lately <$cdef(27)>’s been pullin’
out
all
the
stops
to
make
sure
folks
get
what
they need.

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Yeah, that’s true.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>I saw them <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>clean up a path earlier.

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Right? And all the new grass that’s been popping up?
Bet ya can guess who did that!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Now we’ve got so much sweet, sweet tall grass!

<$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey, I’ve got an idea. Let’s show our support by <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>cheering
them on! Who wouldn’t love that?

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Whoa, that’s a great idea! You’re so smart, <$cdef(27)>Minun! OK,
start us off!
<$voicel(2,7)>All right...<wait(0.8)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)> Let’s! Go! <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>You can do it, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! Don’t give up!

<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,9)><$cdef(27)>! The talented transformer!
YOU’RE
THE COOLEST!

<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,9)>YOU CAN DO IT! YOU CAN DO ANYTHING! BECAUSE...
well, because you’re you! WOOO!
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,4)>*sigh*...
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Huh? Why the long face,  <$cdef(27)>Mime Jr.</color>?

<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,663)><$voicel(2,3)>I’m in a bit of a funk... I need to get better at copying
other Pokémon...
